subject: Re: Next steps - CloudBridge marketplace + Redwood demo
messages:
From: Sara Morris <sara.morris@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Iyer <rajesh.iyer@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + next step (technical deep dive)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro call today. CloudBridge is excited about the potential to list Redwood Inference in our marketplace and to coordinate a joint partner-led demo for a few of our mutual prospects. A quick recap from our side:

- Primary interest: a marketplace listing + co-sell/enablement materials
- Technical ask: brief architecture review and a 60-min technical deep dive/demo for our solutions architects and a target customer
- Timing: customers are looking for a demo next week (week of Mar 23)

Would you and the Redwood SEs be available for a partner-led technical deep dive? Raj (cc'd) will coordinate attendees from CloudBridge. Our suggested agenda: 15m intros, 30m demo (focus on latency/cost controls & model variants), 15m Q&A/integration considerations.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 23, 09:00–10:00
- Wed Mar 24, 11:00–12:00
- Thu Mar 25, 14:00–15:00

We can also run the demo as a joint session with a target customer if Redwood prefers. Attaching our marketplace onboarding doc for context.

Thanks — look forward to locking a time.

Sara Morris
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge Technologies
[sara.morris@cloudbridge.com]
[Attachment: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Onboarding.pdf (application/pdf)]

Subject: Re: Follow-up + next step (technical deep dive)

Sara — great to meet you on the call yesterday, and thanks for the recap + onboarding doc. Quick recap and proposed next steps from Redwood: 

Recap:
- We can commit a partner-led demo focused on marketplace flow, deployment options (Hosted, Dedicated, Private), and a short technical deep dive into inference economics (batching, quantization recommendations).
- We'll have an SE present architecture/latent tradeoffs and a partner PM cover GTM/marketplace steps.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (60m) with CloudBridge solutions architects + Redwood SEs
2) Follow-up A: onboarding checklist & marketplace listing timeline
3) Follow-up B: joint customer intro / POV if needed

Availability: Tue/Wed/Thu next week all work, but to make scheduling easy I've added a Calendly link below. Can CloudBridge confirm the preferred slot and which internal stakeholders will join? We recommend including a CloudBridge marketplace point person + one solutions architect.

My suggested slot from Redwood: Wed Mar 24, 11:00–12:00 PT — this aligns with our SE calendar (Dev and Jonas are cc'd). If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
